sources.title: d1-omni-2B - Liquid AI Docs
sources.snippet: ← Back to Decision Models d1-omni-2B is a 2.17B parameter decision model for text, pictures, and audio, built on LFM3-Omni-2B. It returns calibrated answers in one forward pass, without generating tokens. Clips and spoken questions go through the same pass as text and pictures, so a voice request can be routed, checked, or answered just like a typed one.
